summary.zh-Hans: 还剑湖位于河内，湖北侧的小岛上有玉山祠，一座红色桥梁将小岛与湖岸连接。
summary.en: Hoan Kiem Lake is in Hanoi. Ngoc Son Temple stands on an island near its northern side, connected to the shore by a red bridge.

summary.zh-Hans: 河内文庙始建于1070年，1076年设国子监。文庙的传统建筑与花园分布在五重庭院中。
summary.en: Founded in 1070, Hanoi’s Temple of Literature became home to the Imperial Academy in 1076. Its traditional buildings and gardens are arranged through five courtyards.

summary.zh-Hans: 越南河粉以米制粉条配汤，可搭配牛肉或鸡肉及香草；河内是品尝河粉的城市之一。
summary.en: Pho brings rice noodles together with broth, beef or chicken, and herbs. Hanoi is one of the cities known for this noodle soup.

summary.zh-Hans: 河内烤肉米线将炭烤猪肉、米线、蘸汁和香草等蔬菜搭配食用。
summary.en: Hanoi’s bun cha pairs charcoal-grilled pork with rice vermicelli, dipping sauce, herbs and vegetables.
